title: Channel
description: An old beige television where every channel is a Beatles album broadcast: the cover drifts under scanlines while a lyric caption builds word by word. Turn the knob and it clunks through static and a rolling picture to the next one; press degauss and the screen wobbles back to true colour.
intent: Changing channel as a physical, audible event: a detented knob, a burst of snow and hiss, a vertical roll that settles, and herb's beat coming back through a small TV speaker.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage (old CRT TV with a console), e936 and 70e0 lyric captions
